name: Tel'Abim
_terrain: Turtle's island east of Tanaris on Kalimdor. 3.3.5 has open sea there: tiles x 43 exist as empty sea, x 44-46 do not exist at all (built on a moved stock sea tile and added to Kalimdor.wdt). The stock Lost Rigger Cove coast is on x 42.
_merge_region: Tiles Kalimdor_42_43 .. Kalimdor_47_51; the island and its sea bed are on 43-46 x 44-50 (one tile of margin). Same options as Gillijim's Isle (README 'Terrain modes').
_area_bits: Zone 5121 and subzones 5122-5129 are new to 3.3.5.
_exclude_quests: 41973 Contracts in Moonwhisper Coast and 41975 Zalwan's Cut belong to Gordnak in Moonwhisper Coast (another Turtle zone). 40590/40591 are Gelwig Darkbrow's Tanaris quests (he is added only for Secrets of the Dark Iron Desecrator). 40749 (item-started, no turn-in, its follow-up does not exist) and 41346 (A Mossy Mystery: its key has no source) are unfinished on Turtle and are left out by the build on their own.
_extra_quests: Operation Help Jabbey (Jabbey in Tanaris, Blackrock Depths): the link between 40756 and 40758 of Bixxle Screwfuse's chain.
_extra_spawns: Darneg Darkbeard in Blackrock Depths (map 230): drops the Extremely Potent Snuff for Operation Help Jabbey. Gelwig Darkbrow at Steamwheedle Port (Tanaris): gives the plans for Secrets of the Dark Iron Desecrator.
_spawns_in_whole_region: Spawns are looked for over the whole merge region, not only inside Turtle's world-map rectangle of the zone.
_extra_creature_templates: Quest credits (Gargantuan Information!, The Missing Friend!).
_force_display: Turtle's monkey model (Creature\Monkey) does not exist in 3.3.5 -> the small gorilla (3.3.5 display 21360) for the Peach King, Highvale Chimpanzees and Monkeys, Ebu, Simbu and Nibu.
_extra_gameobject_spawns: The Dark Iron Desecrator (40762): the Magma Condensor Crate in Blackrock Depths and the Intricate Arcanite Barrels in Lower Blackrock Spire.
_exclude_gameobjects: Mosscovered Chest: starts and ends A Mossy Mystery (41346), whose Barnacle Covered Key has no source in Turtle's database (an unfinished treasure hunt) - the quest is left out, so the chest would be an empty quest giver.
